promises.description: Curated vocabulary of allowed capability families (pledge-like).

fs.description: Unveil-like filesystem allowlist. The runtime view is still constructed by mounts; these rules are a review surface.

lock.description: If true, no further filesystem rules may be added by the process after activation.

egress_classes.description: Named egress classes to be granted via the net egress broker (preferred over ambient sockets).

listen_classes.description: Named listen classes to be granted via the listen broker (preferred over ambient listeners).

portals.description: Portal surfaces this profile is allowed to request (e.g., documents, clipboard, notification).

capsicum.description: Optional Capsicum/Casper affordances; concrete enforcement is derived to capset_digest and/or runtime setup.
